title: Little House on the Prairie
description: Mary accepts Adam's proposal, but doubts they can raise children.

title: Heartland
description: Amy and Ty find their dream ranch while Peter tries to mediate for Georgie and Olivia.

title: Heartland
description: Tim tries to change Maggie's into a soulless fast food franchise putting Lou and Tim on opposite sides.

title: Heartland
description: Mallory questions her choices when she finds out that Jake is planning to leave while Amy and Ty work with a mare and foal.

title: Ice Sculpture Christmas
description: An aspiring chef finds romance during Christmastime while preparing for an ice-sculpting competition.

title: A Majestic Christmas
description: An architect returns to her hometown during the holidays to turn a historic playhouse into a modern multiplex, much to the town's objections.

title: Deliver by Christmas
description: Bakery owner Molly meets Josh, a newcomer in town, but is also enchanted by a mysterious client whom she's never met in person. A special wish to be delivered by Christmas could help determine who will win Molly's heart.

title: Karen Kingsbury's The Bridge
description: A woman reunites with an old flame while trying to save a beloved bookstore.

title: Karen Kingsbury's The Bridge Part 2
description: Molly and Ryan fell in love during their freshmen year only to break up when Molly's controlling father meddled in their romance. Seven years later, they are reunited when they try to save the bookstore that changed their lives.

title: A Heavenly Christmas
description: A workaholic's (Kristin Davis) untimely death leads to her recruitment as a Christmas angel. Her first task is to help a struggling singer (Eric McCormack) use his music to heal old wounds.

title: A Holiday Spectacular
description: In 1958, an heiress puts her high-society wedding plans on hold to fulfill her secret dream of dancing in the Radio City Music Hall Christmas Spectacular.

title: A Christmas Duet
description: Fate brings an ex-music duo together over the holidays, just in time for the annual Yuletide Festival.

title: 'Twas the Night Before Christmas
description: A former actress takes charge of a town's annual Christmas Eve courtroom production, in which the true authorship of the famous poem "A Visit From St. Nick" is debated.

title: 'Tis the Season for Love
description: An out-of-work actress (Sarah Lancaster) finds romance after returning to her quaint hometown during Christmastime.

title: Boyfriends of Christmas Past
description: Marketing executive Lauren must learn to open her heart with the help of four ghosts of ex-boyfriends who visit her leading up to Christmas.

title: Christmas in Harmony
description: A music executive heads home to North Carolina to win her job back while also co-directing the church choir with her ex-boyfriend.

title: Sound of Christmas
description: Lizzie, a young piano teacher, helps a school get ready for its major Christmas fundraiser, and she has committed much of her time to planning the event. When she meets Brad, who takes an interest in her piano skills, he asks if she will teach his uninterested teenage daughter to play the piano. She begins to break through to the girl, and sparks fly with Brad, but she is shocked to find out that his interest is not solely in her playing, but in the property that houses the music school.

title: To Have and To Holiday
description: After a brief courtship, Celeste and Jason get engaged. Celeste then asks her pastor father, who's not ready to let his daughter go, to officiate their Christmas wedding.

title: Christmas Encore
description: A struggling actress finds a renewed passion for her craft when she is cast in an off-Broadway show, a modern take on A Christmas Carol.

title: My Christmas Love
description: A hopeless romantic (Meredith Hagner) begins receiving the gifts from The 12 Days of Christmas from an anonymous suitor.

title: Christmas Joy
description: An ambitious market researcher returns home to care for her injured aunt. She's reunited with her former crush, now a hospital administrator.

title: Christmas in Conway
description: Hoping it will be the perfect Christmas present for his wife (Mary-Louise Parker), a man (Andy Garcia) plans to construct a Ferris wheel in his backyard.

title: Christmas Everlasting
description: Christmas is fast approaching and years of long workdays are about to pay off for Lucy. However, when her older sister unexpectedly passes away, Lucy dreads returning to Nilson's Bay to handle her sister's estate.
